description: Risk R-B, stated before anything else because the class name inverts the behaviour: the prompt-mandated Java class for COTRN01C is transaction.TransactionAddController, but this program ADDS NOTHING - it VIEWS. Four independent artefacts say so, and each is quoted rather than merely cited because README.md is rewritten by this migration and the line numbers in circulation have already drifted: app/cbl/COTRN01C.cbl:5 'Function    : View a Transaction from TRANSACT file'; the online transaction inventory table at README.md:314 in this checkout, whose CT01 row records the cells CT01, COTRN01, COTRN01C and 'Transaction View' - the cells are quoted, the table's own column padding is not; app/bms/COTRN01.bms:2 'CardDemo - Transaction View'; and the screen literal INITIAL='View Transaction' at app/bms/COTRN01.bms:75-79, LENGTH=16, POS=(4,30). Rule R1 governs the resolution - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and practice B4 governs the disclosure, so the divergence is documented here and never silently corrected. No insert is asserted: expectedWrites is empty, and on this arm it is empty for a second and stronger reason - PF3 navigates away, so nothing is written and nothing is even read. The half of the swap that genuinely adds a transaction lives in parity/COTRN02C. WHAT THIS CASE PINS: the DFHPF3 arm of the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at :112-132, entered with CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM blank so that :116 IF CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES is TRUE and :117 moves the hard-coded 'COMEN01C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM instead of echoing an empty name. The trace is exactly: :99 finds CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT = 1, so the re-entry branch is taken and the whole first-entry block at :100-109 - including the CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED test at :103 - is skipped; :111 performs RECEIVE-TRNVIEW-SCREEN; :112-115 tests WHEN DFHENTER first, which does NOT match, and only then WHEN DFHPF3, which does; :116-117 default the target; :122 performs RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN; :202-204 rewrite three commarea fields; :205-208 transfer. That the ENTER arm is evaluated and rejected before the PF3 arm matches is the ordering gate G30 asks for, and WHEN OTHER remains last at :128. THE :199-201 FALLBACK IS NOT TAKEN, and that is a real sub-branch outcome rather than a detail: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN opens by defaulting a blank CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM to 'COSGN00C', but :117 has already put 'COMEN01C' there, so the guard is FALSE and the sign-on default does not fire. The case pins both halves of that: CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM arrives as 'COTRN01C' - what COTRN00C would have set when it transferred here - and leaves as 'COMEN01C', which proves :117 overwrites unconditionally rather than filling only a blank, and proves the target is the main menu and not the sign-on screen. Note also that CDEMO-FROM-TRANID arrives as 'CT00' while CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM arrives blank: the :116 guard reads the program name ONLY, so a caller that recorded its transaction id but not its program name still takes the default. A translation that helpfully derived the target from CDEMO-FROM-TRANID would return to the transaction list and would be caught here. NO SEND OCCURS, THEREFORE NO HEADER IS PAINTED. SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN at :213-225 is not performed on this arm, so POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :243-262 never runs and this case asserts no screen field at all: sends is empty, and TITLE01O, TITLE02O, TRNNAMEO, PGMNAMEO, CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are values the program does not set on this path - inventing them would assert behaviour that is not there, and the header projection every sending case in this folder carries is deliberately absent here. No detail field is asserted either, and no CSSETATY highlight: this screen colours nothing in either state, so no DFHRED and no '*' belongs anywhere in this file. THE TWO MESSAGE CHANNELS ARE BLANK, NOT ABSENT. :91-92 open MAIN-PARA with MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE, ERRMSGO OF COTRN1AO, and both fields are reported unconditionally on their own declared widths - WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) and ERRMSGO PIC X(78) - which keeps the 80-to-78 truncation of MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO at :217 visible as two channels rather than one. So the two lines here are all spaces at 80 and 78: there is no DISPLAY line, because :290 is the program's only console output and lies on an arm this case does not reach, and no error text, because no rejecting path runs. An omitted pair would not say the same thing - it would assert a count of zero against two observed lines - so the emptiness is stated as blank content on both channels, which is what 'no message' means for a program that blanks them at entry. NO MAP IS NAMED, AND THAT IS THE READING THE SOURCE SUPPORTS. nextMapset and nextMap are omitted deliberately: the only MAP('COTRN1A') MAPSET('COTRN01') in this program is inside SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN at :219-221, RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN sends nothing before transferring, and EXEC CICS XCTL at :205-208 names a PROGRAM and nothing else - the target paints its own screen. Naming COTRN01/COTRN1A here would tell a client to repaint the screen it is leaving. CDEMO-LAST-MAP and CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET are a separate matter and are echoed exactly as they arrived, because COTRN01C never writes either one. NOTHING IS READ. TRANSACT is declared as a dataset that exists and holds no row - a positive statement, not an omission - so the keyed EXEC CICS READ at :269-278, with the UPDATE option :275 states, could only ever answer DFHRESP(NOTFND) if it were reached. It is not reached: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY belongs to the DFHENTER arm alone. The case makes that unreachability sharp by supplying everything that would otherwise drive a read - a well-formed 16-byte TRNIDINI on the received map, and a non-blank CDEMO-CT01-TRN-SELECTED carried in the commarea - and expecting no read outcome at all: no forced outcome, no FILE STATUS, no RESP, and a final-state row count of zero at the 350-byte width app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy declares. Had the translation taken the ENTER arm, or hoisted the :103 selection test out of the first-entry block, the empty dataset would have produced 'Transaction ID NOT found...' and a send, and the diff count would be non-zero. THE 218 BYTES AND THE ECHO. The area travels in the payload and nowhere else (rule R6, gate G37): app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy is 4+8+4+8+8+1+1 = 34 plus 9+25+25+25 = 84 plus 11+1 = 12 plus 16 plus 7+7 = 14 = 160 bytes, and CDEMO-CT01-INFO at :53-61 is 16+16+8+1+1+16 = 58, so EIBCALEN is 218. The 58-byte extension is carried as its own DTO field rather than folded into the shared 160-byte NavigationContext all seventeen controllers depend on, and this case pins every field of both halves - the customer, account and card identifiers this program never reads included - so a span that shifted, or an extension quietly merged into the commarea, would show up as a field difference rather than as silence. BASELINE PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED, by structured reading of MAIN-PARA and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy and the :53-61 extension summed above; app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy 350 bytes), the BMS field contract (app/cpy-bms/COTRN01.CPY, 21 xxxI payload items, ERRMSGO PIC X(78)), the five-arm AID dispatch that app/bms/COTRN01.bms corroborates independently through its 47-character footer literal 'ENTER=Fetch  F3=Back  F4=Clear  F5=Browse Tran.' at :263-268, POS=(24,1), and the TRANSACT definition in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: running the legacy programs is empirically impossible in this environment, which AAP section 0.7.6 establishes with eight independently verified blockers - among them an absent CICS runtime and the absent IBM-supplied DFHAID copybook this program copies at :71, which is why the DFHPF3 mnemonic is resolved through common.CicsAid (risk R-D). The change of provenance is escalated as risk R-A rather than absorbed silently. GATES DISCHARGED: G15 (one of exactly twenty cases in parity/COTRN01C), G18 (the diff count must be zero, per module rather than per build), G30 (the EVALUATE EIBAID order), G37 (no server-side session state), G40 (the XCTL at :205-208 resolves to the nextProgram response field, 'COMEN01C' at the X(08) width CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM declares - exactly eight characters, so neither padded nor truncated) and G51 (the controller is driven as a plain object, with no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path). Deliberately NOT asserted, because this arm or this program has none of them: G19, G21 and G23 (no record is read, written or seeded, so there is no width, no FILLER and no scale to pin), G32 (zero GO TO), G35 (zero CALL 'CEE3ABD', which is why the return code is 0 and no abend path exists), G38 (no send and no error flag, so no highlight), G39 (no pagination), G43 (no 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC) and G47 (the keyed-read call site is never reached, so no I/O outcome is fabricated for it).
